confirmed.title: 'thang sáu' (only the month word has its mark) is read as NEXT month, not June
confirmed.detail: _vi_period decides June vs next month with re.search(r'tháng\s+sáu', marked), which needs BOTH words marked. People often put marks on only some words. When the deciding word 'sáu' has its mark but 'thang' does not, the text is still read as 'tháng sau' (next month). Text with no marks at all ('thang sau') also silently becomes next month instead of asking which was meant. An NFD-decomposed slot (for example from the model path, which is not NFC-normalised before resolve) also misses the check.
confirmed.repro: With today = 13 Oct 2026: parse_period('thang sáu') -> 1 Nov 2026; parse_period('thàng sáu') -> Nov; registry.match('chạy lương thang sáu') -> run_payroll {'period': 'thang sáu'}, which resolves to November 2026. parse_period(unicodedata.normalize('NFD','tháng sáu')) -> Nov. Only 'tháng sáu' fully marked gives June.
confirmed.fix: Decide on the mark of the word after the month word only: NFC-normalise `raw`, align it with `low` using fold_keep, and test whether the original word at rel.span(1) contains 'á' (sáu) rather than 'a'. When there are no marks at all ('thang sau'), return an ambiguous result (chips: June / next month) instead of silently choosing next month.
